attempts.text:
Only car1 can do any rescue work. The one road out of Dhunche hospital is impassable, so car2 is stuck there. Every rescued person therefore has to go to Trishuli shelter by round trip, which means the car's seats limit how many people can be saved.

| Trip | Route from Trishuli shelter and back | People rescued | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Dupcheshwar care home | 4 elderly | 38 |
| 2 | Uttargaya farm | 3 injured | 48 |
| 3 | Uttargaya farm, Tadi care home | 4 elderly | 70 |
| 4 | Dupcheshwar, Gajuri, Tarkeshwar, Syaphru market | 4 injured | 132 |
| 5 | Dupcheshwar, Gajuri, Tarkeshwar, Benighat care home | 1 elderly, 1 injured, 2 adults | 112 |

**Deferred:** 3 adults (1 at Tarkeshwar market, 2 at Jwalamukhi market) at 20 each, for a penalty of 60. Another trip for them would take at least 94 minutes, which is more than the 60 it would save.

**Why trip 5 goes to Benighat:** it is the best way to collect the remaining people on the western route. Its 112 minutes plus the 60 penalty come to 172. Turning back at Tarkeshwar instead would cost 94 minutes plus a 90 penalty, or 184, because the elderly person at Benighat would be deferred.

I compared these trip combinations by hand rather than running an exhaustive solver, and none of the alternatives I checked was cheaper.

**Total cost:** 400 minutes of driving + 60 in penalties = 460
